description_expanded:
Verisun | Santimo Beach | Seacrest Beach, FL

40 Elysee Court, Inlet Beach, FL 32461

Verisun | 40 Elysee Court is a captivating vacation rental home that provides luxurious furnishing and amenities that will make you never want to leave. Professionally designed by Atlanta Interior Designer, Melanie Turner, enjoy 5 bedrooms + bunk space and 5 ½ bathrooms with a large private pool. This residence is located in the iconic, gated neighborhood Santimo Beach that is perfectly situated between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach.

This residence welcomes you with tall ceilings and an open concept first floor. Modern art and photography is found throughout the home, accompanied with dark muted pastels. The living room, dining and kitchen flow so effortlessly with an ample amount of space. The kitchen proudly features top of the line stainless steel appliances, a large center island, and bar stool seating for 4 guests. The stylish dining table offers seating for 8 guests. The backyard of the home features an appealingly abundant private pool (that can be heated for $65/day), an outdoor dining table, and a grill. There is an elevator in this home and half bathroom on this floor.

The second floor of the home offers the majority of the bedrooms. You will find three guest bedrooms each with a king sized bed and private bathroom. The blush colored master oasis is on this floor and treats you to a king sized bed and private bathroom with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanity sinks. Additionally, the laundry room features two washers and dryers for your convenience.

The third and final floor of the home features a comfortable couch and a tv for the older kids or entire family to gather around situated in a cool toned room. There is a sitting area by the window that overlooks the beautiful Santimo Beach community. A ping pong table is present as well for friendly competition with the family. There is a guest bedroom on this floor with a king sized bed with a 2 twin over twin bunks in a nook. There is a full bathroom with a walk-in shower on this floor.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Additional

- This home has a Ring doorbell mounted by the front door and exterior cameras for safety.

- The Santimio community does not allow LSV (golf cart) rentals

- Parking for 4 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
